title: Fteleport
description: Simple and immersive book-based teleport system for Minecraft servers.
body:
FTeleport
Simple and immersive book-based teleport system for Minecraft servers.
FTeleport lets players manage and use teleport locations through a clean book GUI with cinematic teleport effects. Tested on Minecraft 26.1.2
📖 Book-based teleport menu
🎬 Cinematic teleport effect (darkness transition)
default delay is 20 ticks (recommended: 40 for smoother effect)
visual and sound effects can be disabled separately in config
✨ Features
⚡ Teleport to saved locations
💰 Item-based teleport cost system (item type configurable, price is currently fixed to 1 item)
🌍 Configurable messages & full translation support
🧩 No dependencies (Paper recommended)
🪶 Lightweight and optimized
🧠 How it works
On first join, players automatically receive the teleport book
If the book is lost, it can be re-given using /ft book
Players can save up to 4 personal locations (P1–P4)
Clicking a slot saves the current position
Player has 20 seconds to name the location in chat
Saved locations are shown in the book GUI
Locations can be deleted from the second page of the book
Spawn location is set by admin using /ft spawn
⌨️ Commands
/ft spawn → sets server spawn & first join spawn
/ft p1 – /ft p5 → sets item cost for each
/ft book → gives the teleport book to the player
/ft reload → reloads configuration
💡 Notes
All text is fully configurable in config.yml
Built-in support for translations
Designed to be simple, fast and user-friendly
Created with the help of AI, but fully designed and developed by me
🖥️ Compatibility
Recommended: Paper
Tested on: Paper
May work on: Spigot (not guaranteed)
🚀 Future updates
Teleport cooldown system
VIP slots & permissions
Player statistics
Feedback and suggestions are welcome.
